Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

betaLB 0.1.0

Major

  • The design follows betaSandwich. LB() and the lb context are removed. BetaLB() takes an lm object and returns the standardized slopes and their likelihood intervals (class betalb). RSqLB(), SCorLB(), SCorSqLB(), PCorLB(), DeltaRSqLB(), FSqLB(), and DiffBetaLB() take that object and return class eslb, with the arguments object and alpha = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001).
  • type is one value ("mvn" or "robust") of BetaLB() and is inherited by the effect size functions; std_x takes NULL (all), names, or character(0) (none), as in betaSandwich; effects is removed; blocks moves to DeltaRSqLB() and FSqLB(); control stays on BetaLB().
  • coef(), confint(), summary(), print(), and vcov() methods for both classes. confint() accepts the levels that were computed; vcov() stops with a message (no covariance matrix is defined).

Minor

  • Examples use the nas1982 data, named arguments, and pkg::fn() calls, as in the other beta packages; DeltaRSqLB() and FSqLB() give references.
  • The internal copies from linearAlgebra 0.0.5 (a faster duplication matrix and its exact inverse), nBootstrap 0.1.0 (quantiles in C++), strRegression 0.0.2, and processLM 0.0.11 are current.

betaLB 0.0.0.9002

  • Add SCorSqLB() for the image of a signed-semipartial interval under squaring.

betaLB 0.0.0.9001

Added

  • Added LB() with batched likelihood intervals and seven effect extractors.
  • Added normal-theory and target-specific robust scalar calibration.
  • Added conservative vector-projection intervals for multi-coefficient nonnegative effects, with explicit calibration dimensions and diagnostics.
  • Added signed-square interval images and independent zero-null checks.
  • Added an independent test-only R reference and a native optimizer with analytic gradients, deterministic starts and endpoint verification.
  • Added confidence-level/type selection and explicit failed-endpoint statuses.
  • Retained adjusted R-squared as a labelled finite-sample transformation.

betaLB 0.0.0.9000

Major

  • Initial scaffold of betaLB converted from rProject template.
  • Removed Monte Carlo simulation routines from betaMC.
  • Kept regression input checks and effect-size method infrastructure.
